name: showcase
description: Kitchen-sink app and on-device probe for Solid Multiplatform

scripts.test: vite build && node tests/showcase.e2e.mjs dist/web web chromium && node tests/showcase.e2e.mjs dist/web web firefox && node tests/showcase.e2e.mjs dist/web web webkit
scripts.test:chromium: vite build && node tests/showcase.e2e.mjs dist/web web chromium
scripts.test:firefox: vite build && node tests/showcase.e2e.mjs dist/web web firefox
scripts.test:webkit: vite build && node tests/showcase.e2e.mjs dist/web web webkit
scripts.test:tizen: vite build --mode tizen && node tests/showcase.e2e.mjs dist/tizen tizen chromium
scripts.test:webos: vite build --mode webos && node tests/showcase.e2e.mjs dist/webos webos chromium
